body:
With the weather taking a turn toward shivers and rain boots, we’re back to spending more time indoors. What better time to invest in creating a beautiful, comfortable, cozy nursery to provide the perfect escape from the cold for you and your little one? Using three of our most popular convertible cribs as inspiration, we’ve imagined three festive winter nursery design schemes that we hope will encourage you to create your own!

Remember, keep decorations – especially garland and small pieces – out of reach from baby. Avoid hanging decorations directly on cribs and changing tables, and make sure holiday items within baby’s reach are soft, safe, and ready for snuggles!

Winter Brights

Cold and dreary outside? Create a warm, colorful escape for you and your little one that’s full of imagination. The classic, clean lines of our Boston Crib play nicely with bright holiday stripes, festive decorations, and a sweet snuggly friend or two.

Snowy Snuggles

Live in a warmer climate that leaves you wishing for snowflakes? Infuse the nursery with winter glow in soft snowy neutrals, natural wood accents, and mountaintop magic!

Plaid Perfection

Classic, cozy holiday vibes that feel festive, but stay useful all year long! Black and white buffalo check provides an on-trend pattern pop with warm caramel accessories, comfy knits, and an adorable way to count down those December days.

Planning your own cozy winter nursery? Share your designs and creations with us by tagging @dadadababy or using the #dadadaWinterWonderland.

We can’t wait to see what you dream up next!
